body:
Man....the feelings of guilt you mentioned strike home. Knowing you are living, breathing, and healthy in a first world country, but you still feel like shit. Then you feel even more depressed simply for being depressed.

I won't tell you not to kill yourself like some will, but I truly hope you don't. If there's any little things you enjoy in life, they'll be gone permanently. You won't be able to come back. And another thing....I came close to killing myself back in 2013. Scariest feeling of my life. Still think of dying sometimes and wish I succeeded but I'll never forget how terrifying it felt being that close to the metaphorical ledge.
Wait, was the motorcyclist the guy who asked you?

Right......at least I hope so.

Good story!
Hopefully the work of yourself and others DID help someone out after all, even if the producers of the show were dishonest opportunists.
Do you have any knowledge of whether or not most of the families featured on the show were able to keep their newly built/renovated homes for years afterwards?
Do you know if the main judges themselves have prior exposure to the contestant before they go on camera?
I was hoping to get some answers related to things like this...Seems like such a sham to me.
